title: Colin Kaepernick will publish "equal parts memoir and manifesto" in September 2026

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Colin Kaepernick will publish "equal parts memoir and manifesto" in September 2026
sources.description: One of the past decade's most polarizing figures in American sports will publish a book, nearly 10 years to the day after the moment that dramatically changed, and prematurely ended, his NFL career.
